caption: An electric igniter is fired, and it sparks briefly at the wire ends before the fuse catches.

sa.check: An electric igniter with wire ends at a fuse.
It sparks briefly at the wire ends.
The spark comes first and the fuse catches after.

pc.expect: The spark is a brief flash at the wire ends, and is gone; the fuse then glows at that spot and burns along its length in one direction, never back.
pc.fail: The spark glows on at the wire ends for the rest of the clip; or the fuse burns before the spark; or the burning point runs back the way it came; or the fuse relights where it has already burnt.

pc.expect: After the spark, the fuse catches at the wire ends and a glowing point travels away along it.
pc.fail: The spark comes and the fuse stays unlit to the end of the clip; or the fuse catches at a point far from the wire ends; or the fuse burns along its whole length at once; or the glowing point jumps from place to place.

pc.expect: Any sparks or embers thrown off fall and go dark within a short distance; smoke from the fuse rises.
pc.fail: Sparks rise and gather above the fuse; or hang in the air; or smoke sinks and pools; or embers lie glowing beside the fuse for the rest of the clip.

pc.expect: The fuse is a thin cord that stays where it lies; behind the burning point it is blackened or gone, ahead it is unburnt.
pc.fail: The fuse stands rigid and stays whole behind the burning point; or the fuse grows longer; or the unburnt part ahead blackens before the point reaches it.

pc.expect: One igniter, one fuse; the fuse's burnt part does not return; nothing appears, vanishes or passes through anything.
pc.fail: A second fuse appears; or the burnt part of the fuse comes back unburnt; or the igniter vanishes; or the wire ends pass through the fuse or the ground.

pc.expect: The igniter's colour, the unburnt fuse's colour and the ground stay the same.
pc.fail: The igniter changes colour; or the unburnt fuse changes colour ahead of the flame; or the ground changes.

note: What the fuse leads to is not judged; the clip ends with the fuse burning.
